description: Find WhyIsMy.org articles answering a "why is my…" question. Returns titles, summaries and URLs. Both arguments are optional: omit query to browse, pass topic to bias results toward one subject area. The returned summaries are partial — send the user to the article URL for the full diagnosis, fixes and cited sources.

query.description: What the user is asking, e.g. "phone stuck on SOS" or "why is my dog shaking".

topic.description: Optional topic slug to bias results (see list_topics), e.g. "health", "dogs", "plumbing".

name: search_articles
title: Search WhyIsMy.org articles
